escena: SCENE (Efeonce studio, Santiago, late afternoon): seen from about 60 degrees above a matt dark-oak worktop; one large printed sheet lies on it, filling the picture — down its left edge a column of short unreadable text labels, and beside each one a row of INK-BLUE printed bars of different lengths, real ink on paper with visible paper grain and a slight cockle where the ink is heaviest. There are NO logos, NO icons, NO brand marks and NO company names anywhere on the sheet, and the text is too small and too steeply angled to be read. Caught at the exact moment the low afternoon sun clears the window frame on the left and rakes hard straight across the sheet, so the paper texture and the raised ink catch the light and the far corner of the table drops into open shadow. The marks of the review land on one single row. A stubby ORANGE grease pencil, its tip worn flat, lies where it was put down. 50mm lens at f/4, focus on the marks.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark-oak worktop
lecho.tono: DARK near-black oak in shadow, matte, its grain still just visible
